cards.Back: 充满、浸润于；常用于历史、文化、传统、学术或创新氛围。
cards.Extra: Example: A modern university should be steeped in innovation as well as academic discipline.
Example: Small cities may have the edge in research quality.

cards.Back: 将科研成果商业化，把实验室成果转化为产品、公司或产业价值。
cards.Extra: Kaoyan writing: Universities should learn how to commercialise research responsibly.

cards.Back: 创新集群；由大学、人才、资本、企业、医院、基础设施等共同构成的创新生态。
cards.Extra: Useful topic: technology, education, economy, workplace development.
Example: Many young people are constrained by limited educational resources.

cards.Back: 严重缺乏；比 lack 更形象、更强烈。
cards.Extra: Example: Rural schools are often starved of qualified teachers.

cards.Back: 概念验证；证明一个想法、技术或商业模式初步可行。
cards.Extra: Common context: technology, startups, research commercialisation.

cards.Back: 规避风险的、谨慎避险的。
cards.Extra: Example: Overly risk-averse investors may slow innovation.

cards.Back: 相互补充；强调两个事物不是替代关系，而是互补关系。
cards.Extra: Writing: Online education and traditional classrooms can complement one another.

cards.Back: 吸引人才；lure 在新闻英语中常表示“吸引、诱使”。
cards.Extra: Example: Better research funding can lure global talent.

cards.Front: not so much A as B
cards.Back: 与其说 A，不如说 B；重点强调 B。
cards.Extra: Example: Online learning has not so much replaced traditional education as expanded its possibilities.

cards.Back: 主语从句结构：It 是形式主语，that 从句是真正主语。含义：……并非巧合。
cards.Extra: Writing: It is no coincidence that successful cities often combine education, capital and infrastructure.

cards.Back: 前者……，后者……；用于对前文提到的两个对象进行对比。
cards.Extra: Example: The former offers flexibility; the latter provides discipline.

cards.Back: whereas 引出强对比，常译为“然而/而”。
cards.Extra: Use it to compare two systems, countries, generations, or education models.

cards.Back: 缺乏、匮乏；常接抽象或资源类名词，如 capital, evidence, talent。
cards.Extra: Example: A dearth of long-term funding can weaken scientific innovation.

cards.Back: Innovation needs more than excellent universities: it also needs capital, infrastructure, markets and cross-regional cooperation.
cards.Extra: 作文迁移：科技创新、教育发展、经济高质量发展、人才流动。

cards.Back: Education and learning; economy; technology and everyday life; workplace and career development; cultural exchange.
cards.Extra: 用于考研英语作文素材归类。

cards.Back: A successful innovation ecosystem depends not only on talent, but also on capital, infrastructure and access to markets.
cards.Extra: 适用话题：科技创新、城市发展、教育、经济。
